newsitem.title: UK: Imperial rebounds on renewed bid talk.
newsitem.headline: Imperial rebounds on renewed bid talk.

text.p: Shares in Britain's Imperial Tobacco rebounded on Thursday as old rumours of a dawn raid resurfaced in the market on Thursday, dealers said.
And although dealers expressed scepticism about the takeover talk, the shares rose 9p to a four-week high of 378-1/2p by 1110 GMT.
"If anyone really believed there was a bid out there, (the shares) would be trading at well over four pounds," said one marketmaker.
He said the decline earlier this week, in anticipation the budget would hike taxes on cigarettes, was overdone.
